words: Format: Lesson - a training lesson for staff with quick checks inside the picture.
Script: Keep it, fix slips - same wording and order; only transcription slips corrected (phishing, 9595 / 9696).
Look: Paper documentary - warm paper ground, ink lines, condensed headline type, dashboards drawn as paper cards.
Voice: Edge, male - a calm English male narrator.

Agent's own choices, for the user to review: en-US-GuyNeural instead of en-US-AndrewNeural (Edge returned no audio for Andrew with word timings on the day); the question lines, the summary line and the practice were added to the source script; every name, date and count on screen is illustrative, as in the source video.

look.notation: thousands with a no-break space (2 899); percentages to one decimal with a space before %; 'UR', 'ISA', 'DLP', 'KPI' spelled out by the voice

pacing.checks: one quick check after each of the first two steps, practice at the end

models.note: every step ran in the main conversation on its model at the host's default effort; no subagents
